declared_before: any proxy run of this study and any teacher-side metric computed in this study
prior_information_disclosed: REVIEW_20261123.md section 3.2 already reported train-R8 false-unreached 1.65% (case-cluster bootstrap [1.56%, 1.74%]) for the all-fragment configuration declared below; the declaration is therefore not blind to that single number. It is fixed here so that the gate result cannot be tuned by the sweep in this study.

gate.implementation: identified-pair procedure of bootstrap_proxy_teacher.py::_metrics (see amendments[0]); exposure_audit unmasked as secondary
gate.evaluation_set: all 2,000 train cases (R=8) of artifacts/datasets/recovery_role_r8_r32_train2000_eval300_20261122, loaded via tools.evaluate_proxy_teacher_distribution.load_development_evidence; sealed test never decoded
supplementary_not_gating: case-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of the pair rate

declared_proxy_configuration.azimuths_per_ring: all fragments (1_000_000, i.e. one ray per fragment)

reproduction_oracle: expected_hits of this configuration must equal review_20261123/proxy_variants.npz v2_lambda bit-for-bit on all 2,300 development cases; otherwise the gate run is void
post_hoc_policy: Any other configuration evaluated on the train gate in this study (for example a recommended default chosen from the sweep) is reported as post-hoc and secondary; it cannot replace the declared result.

amendments.still_before: any proxy run of this study and any teacher-side metric computed in this study
amendments.change: Primary gate implementation aligned with the procedure that produced the original 7.56%/7.60% numbers (pipeline_expected_actual_20261122/work/proxy_teacher/bootstrap_proxy_teacher.py::_metrics): pairs restricted to hurdle p_hit mask (identified pairs), proxy unreached = 1-exp(-expected_hits) == 0, false = teacher fragment_metrics.hit_indicator.mean > 0, Wilson z=1.959963984540054. The unmasked damage_engine.exposure_audit.build_exposure_teacher_audit result is reported as a secondary number.
amendments.reason: The original declaration named exposure_audit, which does not apply the identified-pair mask that the pre-existing gate evaluation used; the gate must be re-evaluated with the same procedure.
